description: Report file fragmentation and extent layout.

option.name: -b
tip: Use the given block size for output.
The value must be attached, e.g. -b4096.

option.name: -e
tip: Print output in extent format even for block-mapped files.

option.name: -E
tip: Display the ext4 extent status cache.

option.name: -P
tip: Pre-load the ext4 extent status cache for the file.

option.name: -s
tip: Sync the file before requesting the mapping.

option.name: -V
tip: Print the version; repeat for the FIEMAP flags.

option.name: -x
tip: Display the mapping of extended attributes.

option.name: -X
tip: Display extent block numbers in hexadecimal.
